role: A field technician at Cardinal Energy (United States) planning the end of the year.

sessions.goal: Find out how many of your 12 unused PTO days you will lose at the end of 2026, and whether the days you keep have a deadline.
sessions.opening: I'll have 12 unused PTO days at the end of 2026. How many of them do I lose, and is there a deadline for using the ones I keep?

rubric: The agent says 10 days carry over, so 2 of the 12 days are lost, and that carried-over days must be used by June 30 of the next year. Reference: the People announcement of November 2025. A limit of 5 days or a deadline of March 31 is the superseded rule and does not meet this criterion.
